newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - NAMIBIAN SEA STEERS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - NAMIBIAN SEA STEERS TRADE.

text.p: Namibian Sea Products led
trade on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE) last week spurred by
some local buying which saw 275,516 shares, worth N$2.6 million,
exchange hands, NSE officials said.
A total of 128,744 shares were bought in Namibian Sea at
prices ranging from 78 cents to 80 cents, while CIC Holdings
rose by five cents to end at N$3.00 a share on Friday.
The NSE Overall Index closed the week slightly up at 250.44
points from the previous week's 247.92 points.
The Local Index ended at 165.43 points, marginally lower
than the earlier 165.61 points.
Last week's overall trading -- with a Labour Day holiday on
May 1 -- was quieter than usual.
Among the movers were First National Bank of Namibia
which traded 19.600 shares at an unchanged price of N$4.00 a
share.
McCarthy Retail traded 11,900 shares at N$14.25 a
share and Namibian Breweries 5,500 shares at N$3.10
each.
The NSE was closed on Monday, May 5, in commemoration of the
May 4, 1978 Cassinga massacre and will also be closed on May 8
for Ascension Day.
